text_block_list.text: Duramente was part of a vintage generation, brimming with talented Umamusume shining in their own unique ways.
Standing at the pinnacle above the rivals she had contested legendary races with, Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaa~~h!
Kita-chan, Dura-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dàjiā hǎo!
Please take good care of me today!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... I'll, do my best... so I don't hold everyone back.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO~~! Crown, Cheval~~!!

At an event bringing together Umamusume of her generation...
Duramente was participating as the center!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone,
thank you for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I hear that many people who support our generation have gathered here today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"A generation is a curious thing.
All it means is that we debuted at the same time, yet—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe that only they
could have been worthy rivals.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of them
that I was able to be... Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to take this opportunity to thank everyone
who sent us their warm thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're so stiff, Dura-san!
At times like this, you've just gotta go straight for it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's shout together!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: S-Shout?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Loud and clear! Ready... go...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And now, please listen.
"Soshite Minna no"—

"The concert ended, and during
the meet-and-greet with each fan—"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente-san,
you were super cool~!
I'll keep cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a huge fan of your father...!
Thank you for giving me just as much excitement as his matches did!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Even among that incredible lineup,
you were the only one shining in my eyes the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan C
text_block_list.text: No matter what Umamusume appears from here on... you will always, forever be number one to me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.
Duramente thanked each fan individually and courteously. Though few in words, her sincerity was undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Please shake my hand too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Umm... like, "we both did our best," maybe?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I say that... but I've lost every single GⅠ!
I keep losing to Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I used to think Dura-san
was just like my idol, Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"You're strong, and you carry so many people's hopes.
I'm so glad someone as cool as you is my rival!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Kitasan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With Duramente there for us to strive toward,
we can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of girl steps up from here on,
Ms. Dura will surely stand in their way again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We'll be the ultimate rivals... far into the future!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Together, we will carry history forward—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I will continue to be...
the strongest for everyone.
